_matrixAnalyse: Two distinct conversion signals drive this ad group. First, the bootcamp itself : 'coding bootcamp' (251 clk, CVR 6.9%) and 'coding bootcamp Belgium' (114 clk, CVR 9.0%) are the volume anchors. Second, the employment outcome : 'ICT jobs' (178 clk, CVR 4.2%) converts solidly — these users want a job as much as training. 'IT traineeship' (11 clk, CVR 18.2%) and 'learn to code' (11 clk, CVR 18.2%) show the highest CVR, signalling strong purchase intent when the practical outcome is clear. The page must explicitly bridge training and ICT employment — not just sell a course.
